title: Vetting Session — payload
description: A vetter opens a vetting session with an applicant whose request it accepted, while the two are together in person or on a call. The request issues the session challenge and names the claims to present; the applicant's response is the signed Vetting Card. This document's `id` is the value the resulting Vetting Statement carries as `taskContext`, and its task digest is what binds the statement to it.

requestId.description: The `requestId` from the vetter's acceptance of the applicant's vetting request.

challenge.description: 32 fresh random bytes, base64url without padding. The card binds to it. Never reused across sessions.

domain.description: The community DID the applicant is being vetted for. The card binds to it alongside `challenge`.

requiredClaims.description: Claim types the card must carry. The community criterion's `requiredClaims`; the identity commitment is computed over exactly these.

optionalClaims.description: Claim types the applicant may add. Never part of the commitment.

expiresAt.description: When the session lapses: no card is accepted for it afterwards, and the card's own `expiresAt` may not be later.

Response.title: Vetting Session — response payload
Response.description: The applicant's signed Vetting Card, bound to this session.
